coordinateConvention: Apply glTF world transform, then (x,-z,y) to Blender axes.
identityConvention: Stable IDs below are r07 audit rows; new grid IDs start at the r07 vertex count. Each export is independently mapped to its audit. Exported triangle rows are not native Blender polygon IDs.

sharedVertexPatchIntersections.method: All pairs within each receipt fan, including pairs Open3D omits due to a shared center. Noncoplanar pairs are tested for a ray lying strictly inside both triangle cones beyond the shared center; nearly coplanar pairs use 2D convex clipping. Thresholds: normal cross <=1e-9 for coplanarity, overlap area >1e-14, interior ray length >1e-7 and midpoint barycentric weights >1e-8.
sharedVertexPatchIntersections.indexConvention: receiptCapTriangleIds indexes incidentExportTriangleIds; auditTriangleVertexRows are exported vertex rows for this test.

patchCorrespondence.method: Flood-fill dual face graph after cutting the actual declared 72 boundary edges; seed with removed r07 rows or new grid rows. This includes old triangles recreated exactly by grid triangulation.

localIntersectionMethod: Open3D non-shared-vertex triangle pairs in the common expanded head AABB, supplemented by all shared-vertex triangle-cone tests incident to each patch vertex including boundary exterior triangles. No whole-model certification.
limits: No geometry or replacement coordinates authored.
Numerical checks do not grant anatomical or visual approval.
Triangle quality and boundary normal angles are measurements, not imposed circularity or smoothness requirements.
Shared-vertex testing uses the inherited diagnostic triangle-cone tolerances stated in each result; local tests do not cover the whole body.
